components.name: OnboardingGuard
components.purpose: Client guard wrapping dashboard children: resolves guest/auth/onboarding state, redirects via router.replace, and renders either a centered thin bottom-arc spinner (while hydrating or session loading), null (while redirecting), or children.
components.props: export default function OnboardingGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }). Uses useSession (next-auth), useGuestStore/useGuestHydrated, useGuestProfileStore/useGuestProfileHydrated, usePathname, useRouter. Redirect targets: /onboarding, /planner, /login. Allow-list paths: pathname === '/onboarding', pathname.startsWith('/help').

oddities: Fourth brand hex #003E7E (outside the #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA trio) is used as the auth gradient start (from-[#003E7E]) and as the hover fill for hand-rolled primary buttons (hover:bg-[#003E7E]) in error.tsx, global-error.tsx, not-found.tsx — effectively an untokenized 'brand-dark'.

Two different spinner designs: loading.tsx uses 'h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-gray-200 border-t-[#153974]' (track + navy arc, with label) while OnboardingGuard uses 'animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-[#3069B3]' (no track, thinner, blue, no label).
Three different min-height conventions for centered states: min-h-[400px] (loading.tsx, error.tsx), min-h-[50vh] (OnboardingGuard), min-h-screen (global-error.tsx, not-found.tsx).
src/app/error.tsx and src/app/(dashboard)/error.tsx are byte-identical duplicates; root error.tsx still uses min-h-[400px] though it is not inside the shell.

global-error.tsx retry button omits the focus ring (focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00AACA] focus:ring-offset-2) that error.tsx and not-found.tsx include, and omits the space-y-2 text wrapper; it also uses double quotes vs single quotes elsewhere.

Status pages hand-roll the primary button ('rounded-md bg-[#153974] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#003E7E] ...') instead of using the shared ui Button, duplicating primary styling. The gradient-tint hover direction differs from nav (bg-[#153974]/10).
Login root is 'min-h-screen flex' but Register root is 'flex-1 flex' — sibling auth pages size their root differently.

Decorative blob geometry drifts between login (w-32/w-40/w-24 at top-20 left-20 / bottom-32 right-32 / top-1/2 right-20; anim-delay-300/500) and register (w-36/w-44/w-28 at top-24 right-24 / bottom-40 left-32 / top-1/3 left-24; anim-delay-400/600).

Purple (bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 nav; bg-purple-100 text-purple-600 notification chip) is used as an 'admin / announcement' semantic color but is not part of the brand palette and appears nowhere else in these files.
Unread badge color depends on user role (admin: bg-yellow-400 text-yellow-900; student: bg-red-500 text-white) — role-based coloring of a count badge is unusual and undocumented.

Yellow vs amber mix: notification 'feedback-new' chip uses bg-yellow-100 / text-yellow-600 and admin badge uses yellow-400/900, while the guest banner and in-app warning use amber-50/100/200/700/800/900.
Same action has three copy variants: 'Google로 로그인' (login form, Latin), '구글 로그인' (header ghost button), '구글로 로그인' (guest banner).
Google button icon is monochrome (all 4 paths fill=currentColor) rather than the official multi-color Google G; it is also hand-inlined rather than a shared icon.

Accent link hover directions conflict: '모두 읽음' is text-[#00AACA] hover:text-[#153974] (cyan -> navy) while guest button is text-gray-500 hover:text-[#153974] and footer links are text-[#153974] hover:underline (no color change).

Many borders have no color: header 'border-b', dropdown 'border', mobile separators 'border-t my-1', dropdown headers 'border-b'. Tailwind v4's default border color is currentColor unless globals.css restores gray-200 — needs verifying against the globals.css reader. Explicit border colors elsewhere vary: border-gray-300 (login divider), border-gray-50 (notification rows, nearly invisible), border-gray-200 (spinner track).
Hover feedback intensity inconsistent: nav links and dropdown items use hover:bg-gray-50 (very faint on white), while bell button and mobile toggle use hover:bg-gray-100.
Contrast concerns: text-gray-400 timestamps (~2.5:1 on white) and text-gray-300 empty-state icon fail WCAG AA; badge text is text-[10px]; text-blue-100 on the #003E7E→#3069B3 gradient is fine.
Mobile menu toggle has English aria-label 'Toggle menu' in an otherwise Korean UI and lacks aria-expanded; dropdown triggers do set aria-expanded/aria-haspopup.
Active-route matching uses three rules: primary exact (pathname === href), admin prefix (pathname.startsWith(href)), secondary (=== || startsWith(href + '/')).
Icon size class ordering is mixed: 'w-4 h-4' / 'w-6 h-6' in layout/auth vs 'h-8 w-8' in error/loading/not-found.
Radius mix: nav pills and inline alerts rounded-md; dropdowns and in-app warning box rounded-lg; error <pre> plain 'rounded'.
Button size='sm' instances in the header are overridden with 'text-xs sm:text-sm whitespace-nowrap', fighting the component's own size scale.
next/image logos use className h-* plus style={{ width: 'auto' }} together with width/height props — a 'w-auto' class would avoid the inline style.
OnboardingGuard returns null (blank content area) in several redirect branches rather than keeping the spinner, causing a flash of empty content before router.replace.
'로딩 중...' uses three ASCII periods instead of an ellipsis; iOS hint uses ꞏꞏꞏ (U+A78F MODIFIER LETTER MIDDLE DOT x3) to imitate Safari's more button.
Mobile logout button lacks the transition-colors class that every sibling mobile nav item has.

Custom utilities text-gradient, bg-grid, bg-mesh, animate-gradient, animate-float, anim-delay-*, animate-fade-in(-up/-down) come from globals.css and were not resolved here (covered by another reader).
